text:
jordan: quick sync — planning to enable `kv_prefetch_v2` and `microbatch_coalesce_v3` flags for inference-pool-3 tomorrow 09:00 PT. initial audience: 10% EU traffic + 5% internal (team testers). rolling to 20% if 30m health checks pass. tl;dr: need ops + oncall signoff and a short perf validation run

mike: thanks — do we have an ordered dependency? should microbatch be enabled only after prefetch is stable?

jordan: good Q. current plan: flip `kv_prefetch_v2` first (makes cache warm), wait 10m, then enable `microbatch_coalesce_v3`. reason: prefetch reduces cold-kv misses which can otherwise amplify microbatch latency spikes.

anya: can you paste the gate config you'll use? want to ensure our toggles map cleanly to routes.

jordan: copying config snippet:
```json
{
  "audience": {
    "eu": 0.10,
    "internal": 0.05
  },
  "stages": [
    { "flag": "kv_prefetch_v2", "wait_min": 600 },
    { "flag": "microbatch_coalesce_v3", "wait_min": 1800 }
  ],
  "rollback_if": {
    "p95_latency_increase_pct": 15,
    "error_rate_increase_pct": 2.0
  }
}
```

kelly: looks reasonable. two asks: (1) add GPU util > 85% as an additional rollback trigger (we hit that last time), (2) isolate a canary cohort that's not latency-sensitive (recommend background-embeddings route).

jordan: added GPU util to rollback clause and switched internal cohort to background-embeddings. updated plan on the rollout doc.

devops-bot: scheduled flag flip `kv_prefetch_v2` at 2026-03-18T09:00:00-07:00 for audience {eu:10%, internal:5%}. Will post checkpoints to #eng-oncall.

anya: for perf validation — suggest running the smoke script against canary nodes: `./tools/smoke_test.sh --model rdx-3b --qps 25 --duration 600`. capture `p50/p95/p99` and `err_rate` and GPU/CPU.

mike: i'll run smoke script from eu-dev rig right after kv flip and paste results. also will run a short golden prompt diff to check output regressions.

oncall-lead: oncall will be watching. escalation plan: if p95 > baseline *1.15 or GPU util >85% for 5m, we'll flip both flags off and promote a debug snapshot. please ensure alerting rules are enabled: `inference.p95.latency`, `inference.error_rate`, `gpu.util`

jordan: noted. rollback commands for quick ops: `platformctl flag set kv_prefetch_v2 false --env production` and `platformctl flag set microbatch_coalesce_v3 false --env production` — use `--force` if automated gate doesn't respond.

kelly: can we add a short smoke log snippet to the ops playbook? sample expected output from `smoke_test`:
```
[SMOKE] qps=25 dur=600 p50=62ms p95=210ms p99=480ms err_rate=0.12% gpu=62%
```

jordan: done. also added a small tracing hook in the runtime to tag requests that hit both prefetch+microbatch so we can query traces: `trace.tag("kv_prefetch_v2+microbatch_v3")`.

mike: ran smoke after kv flip — p95 +4%, gpu 60%, err_rate unchanged. copying raw lines: `[SMOKE] p50=60ms p95=218ms p99=490ms err=0.11% gpu=61%`. looks safe to enable microbatch in 10m.

anya: i'll validate output diffs. if any >0.5 token divergence on golden prompts we halt.

oncall-lead: all set from oncall perspective. i'll be online at flip time for fast rollback. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks everyone — plan is to proceed. i'll post another update when microbatch goes live and when we hit 20% or trigger rollback. action items: mike -> run smoke and paste, anya -> run diff checks, kelly -> watch GPU alerts, oncall -> standby.

mike: ack :white_check_mark:

anya: ack :mag:
